path_contract.causal_clock_rule: AWARE event_at <= available_at <= decision_time with strictly increasing event_at after path_started_at.
path_contract.expiry_rule: EXACT path_started_at + requested_horizon_seconds; requested_horizon_seconds <= frozen_horizon_seconds; extension forbidden.

belief_contract.path_registry_digest_rule: LOWERCASE_SHA256_OF_UTF8_JSON_DUMPS_ON_THE_EXACT_ORDERED_PATH_REGISTRY_ARRAY_WITH_ENSURE_ASCII_TRUE_SORT_KEYS_TRUE_AND_SEPARATORS_COMMA_COLON; exact row fields and all array orders are significant.
